about: FM-1 Pocket Player publishing policy. A firmware is published only if its id is in `approved` and its licence (as the .rfm1 states it) is unchanged. New ids, and approved ids whose licence changes, wait for review: the nightly job opens a 'pocket-review' issue; add the 'approved' label to accept it. `excluded` ids are never published or requested. `smokeExceptions` documents why a firmware may skip one part of the boot test.
